description_en: Queries the precise access control rules configured for a website
description_zh: 查询网站业务精确访问控制规则
name: DescribeWebPreciseAccessRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domains

parameters.help_en:
The source of the rule. Valid values:

manual (default): The rule is manually created.

clover: The rule is automatically generated
parameters.help_zh:
筛选规则来源。取值：
manual（默认）：手动添加
clover：自动生成
parameters.name: owner

PreciseAccessConfigList.description_en: The precise access control rules for the website
PreciseAccessConfigList.description_zh: 网站业务精确访问控制规则

Domain.description_en: The domain name of the website

Action.description_en:
The action that is performed on requests that match the rule. Valid values:

accept: allows the requests.

block: blocks the requests.

challenge: triggers a JavaScript Challenge for the requests
Action.description_zh:
匹配动作。取值：
accept：放行
block：封禁
challenge：挑战

ContentList.description_en:
The match conditions of the rule. The value is a JSON string. The value contains the following fields:

If you specify multiple match conditions, the logical relation between these conditions is AND.

field: The match field. This parameter is of the string type.

match_method: The match method. This parameter is of the string type.

For more information about the valid values of field and match_method, see the "Additional information about field and match_method" section in this topic.

content: The match content. This parameter is of the string type.

header_name: The name of the header field. This parameter is of the string type. This parameter is required only when field is set to header
ContentList.description_zh:
规则的匹配条件。具体结构如下。
如果设置了多个匹配条件，则多个条件间是且的关系。

field：String类型，匹配字段。
match_method：String类型，匹配方法。
 
关于field和match_method的取值，请参见请求参数表下的补充描述。

content：String类型，匹配内容。
header_name：String类型，头部字段名称。仅在field为header时生效

HeaderName.description_en:
The name of the custom HTTP header field.

This parameter is required only when Field is set to header
HeaderName.description_zh:
自定义HTTP头部字段名称。

仅在Field为header时有效

ExpirePeriod.description_en: The validity period of the rule. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
ExpirePeriod.description_zh: 规则有效期时间戳。单位：秒

Expires.description_en: The validity period of the rule. Unit: seconds. This parameter is required only when the action of the rule is block. Requests that match the rule are blocked within the validity period. A value of 0 indicates that the rule is permanently valid
Expires.description_zh: 规则有效期。单位：秒。规则的匹配动作为阻断时（action为block）生效，在规则有效期内阻断访问请求。0表示永久生效

Owner.description_en:
The source of the rule. Valid values:

manual (default): The rule is manually created.

clover: The rule is automatically generated
Owner.description_zh:
规则来源。取值：
manual：手动添加（默认）
clover：自动生成
